title: Italian Quesadilla Fritters
description: Crispy Italian-inspired fritters filled with a savory quesadilla mixture, perfect for a quick snack or appetizer.

ingredients.name: mediterranean cheese blend
ingredients.notes: such as feta, parmesan, and ricotta

instructions: In a large bowl, combine bread cubes, quesadilla sauce, tortilla strips, and cheese blend. Mix well.
Add enchilada seasoning if using and mix until combined.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Using a 1/4 cup measuring cup, scoop the mixture and shape into balls.
Place the balls onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 12-15 minutes or until crispy and golden brown.
